10444-the-peace-negotiations-a-personal-.title: The Peace Negotiations A Personal Narrative
10444-the-peace-negotiations-a-personal-.creator: Unknown
10444-the-peace-negotiations-a-personal-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "While we were still in Paris, I felt, and have felt increasingly ever since, that you accepted my guidance and direction on questions with regard to which I had to instruct you only with increasing reluctance....

30453-the-boy-scout-fire-fighters.title: The Boy Scout Fire Fighters
30453-the-boy-scout-fire-fighters.creator: Unknown
30453-the-boy-scout-fire-fighters.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. the finest exhibition of firemanship was when one of the nozzlemen let go of the only hose they got on the fire while he hunted through his pockets for a paper of tobacco or something else just as important," said Bruce. "Of course the other nozzleman couldn't hold onto the hose alone and it twisted out of his hands.

77231-the-trail-of-the-golden-horn.title: The Golden Horn
77231-the-trail-of-the-golden-horn.creator: H. A. Cody
77231-the-trail-of-the-golden-horn.description: A book by H. A. Cody. Hugo, the trapper, rasped forth these words upon the stinging air as he paused abruptly upon the brow of a steep hill. He was puzzled, and he rubbed the frost from his eyelids with his mittened right hand. Perhaps he had not seen aright. But no, he had not been mistaken. There, close to the river, stood the little cabin, nestling amidst a grove of young firs and jack-pines. But no smoke poured from the pipe stuck up through the roof.

arxiv-2012-14449.title: Excitation spectra of quantum matter without quasiparticles II: random t t - J J models
arxiv-2012-14449.creator: Maria Tikhanovskaya, Haoyu Guo, Subir Sachdev, Grigory Tarnopolsky
arxiv-2012-14449.description: Abstract We present numerical solutions of the spectral functions of t t - J J models with random and all-to-all exchange and global SU( M M ) spin rotation symmetry. The solutions are obtained from the saddle-point equations of the large volume limit, followed by the large M M limit.

arxiv-2203-17141.title: Angular Resolution of the Search for Anisotropic Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background with Terrestrial Gravitational-Wave Detectors
arxiv-2203-17141.creator: Erik Floden, Vuk Mandic, Andrew Matas, Leo Tsukada
arxiv-2203-17141.description: Abstract We consider an anisotropic search for the stochastic gravitational-wave (GW) background by decomposing the gravitational-wave sky into its spherical harmonics components. Previous analyses have used the diffraction limit to define the highest-order spherical harmonics components used in this search.

arxiv-2209-11376.title: The jet formation mechanism of Gamma-ray Narrow-line Seyfert 1 Galaxies 2022 The jet formation mechanism of Gamma-ray Narrow-line Seyfert 1 Galaxies – References
arxiv-2209-11376.creator: Yongyun Chen(陈永云), Qiusheng Gu(顾秋生), Junhui Fan(樊军辉), Xiaoling Yu (俞效龄), Nan Ding(丁楠), Xiaotong Guo (郭晓通), Dingrong Xiong(熊定荣)
arxiv-2209-11376.description: Abstract Under the coronal magnetic field, we estimate the maximal jet power of the Blandford–Znajek (BZ) mechanism, Blandford–Payne (BP) mechanism, and hybrid model. The jet power of the BZ and Hybrid model mechanisms depends on the spin of a black hole, while the jet power of the BP mechanism does not depend on the spin of a black hole.

arxiv-2303-11133.title: Sturmian and infinitely desubstitutable words accepted by an ω \omega -automaton
arxiv-2303-11133.creator: Pierre Béaur, Benjamin Hellouin de Menibus
arxiv-2303-11133.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pierre Béaur, Benjamin Hellouin de Menibus. Given an ω \omega -automaton and a set of substitutions, we look at which accepted words can also be defined through these substitutions, and in particular if there is at least one. We introduce a method using desubstitution of ω \omega -automata to describe the structure of preimages of accepted words under arbitrary sequences of homomorphisms: this takes the form of a meta- ω \omega -automaton.

arxiv-2307-05420.title: Similarity-Based Parameter Transferability in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
arxiv-2307-05420.creator: Alexey Galda, Eesh Gupta, Jose Falla, Xiaoyuan Liu, Danylo Lykov, Yuri Alexeev, Ilya Safro
arxiv-2307-05420.description: Abstract The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) is one of the most promising candidates for achieving quantum advantage through quantum-enhanced combinatorial optimization. A near-optimal solution to the combinatorial optimization problem is achieved by preparing a quantum state through the optimization of quantum circuit parameters.

arxiv-2311-07881.title: Accurate estimates of dynamical statistics using memory
arxiv-2311-07881.creator: Chatipat Lorpaiboon, Spencer C. Guo, John Strahan, Jonathan Weare, Aaron R. Dinner
arxiv-2311-07881.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chatipat Lorpaiboon, Spencer C. Guo, John Strahan, Jonathan Weare, Aaron R. Dinner. Many chemical reactions and molecular processes occur on timescales that are significantly longer than those accessible by direct simulation. One successful approach to estimating dynamical statistics for such processes is to use many short time series observations of the system to construct a Markov state model (MSM), which approximates the dynamics of the system as memoryless transitions between a set of discrete states.

arxiv-2402-03110.title: Non-Stationary Latent Auto-Regressive Bandits
arxiv-2402-03110.creator: Anna L. Trella, Walter Dempsey, Asim H. Gazi, Ziping Xu, Finale Doshi-Velez, Susan A. Murphy
arxiv-2402-03110.description: Abstract For the non-stationary multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem, many existing methods allow a general mechanism for the non-stationarity, but rely on a budget for the non-stationarity that is sub-linear to the total number of time steps T T . In many real-world settings, however, the mechanism for the non-stationarity can be modeled, but there is no budget for the non-stationarity.

arxiv-2402-10125.title: Energy Flux Decomposition in Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
arxiv-2402-10125.creator: Damiano Capocci \aff 1 \corresp, Perry L. Johnson \aff 2, Sean Oughton \aff 3, Luca Biferale \aff 1, Moritz Linkmann \aff 4 \corresp
arxiv-2402-10125.description: Abstract In hydrodynamic (HD) turbulence an exact decomposition of the energy flux across scales has been derived that identifies the contributions associated with vortex stretching and strain self-amplification (P. Johnson, Phys. Rev. Lett. , 124, 104501 (2020), J. Fluid Mech. 922, A3 (2021)) to the energy flux across scales.

arxiv-2412-02235.title: Testing vs Estimation for Index-Invariant Properties in the Huge Object Model
arxiv-2412-02235.creator: Sourav Chakraborty, Eldar Fischer, Arijit Ghosh, Amit Levi, Gopinath Mishra, Sayantan Sen
arxiv-2412-02235.description: Abstract The Huge Object model of property testing [Goldreich and Ron, TheoretiCS 23] concerns properties of distributions supported on { 0 , 1 } n \{0,1\}^{n} , where n n is so large that even reading a single sampled string is unrealistic.

arxiv-2503-22335.title: A numerical Bernstein splines approach for nonlinear initial value problems with Hilfer fractional derivative
arxiv-2503-22335.creator: Niels Goedegebure, Kateryna Marynets
arxiv-2503-22335.description: Abstract The Hilfer fractional derivative interpolates the commonly used Riemann-Liouville and Caputo fractional derivative. In general, solutions to Hilfer fractional differential equations are singular for t ↓ 0 t\downarrow 0 and are difficult to approximate with high numerical accuracy. We propose a numerical Bernstein splines technique to approximate solutions to generalized nonlinear initial values problems with Hilfer fractional derivatives.

arxiv-2510-21954.title: Model-Aware Tokenizer Transfer
arxiv-2510-21954.creator: Mykola Haltiuk & Aleksander Smywiński-Pohl
arxiv-2510-21954.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are trained to support an increasing number of languages, yet their predefined tokenizers remain a bottleneck for adapting models to lower-resource or distinct-script languages. Existing tokenizer transfer methods typically rely on semantic heuristics to initialize new embeddings, ignoring higher-layer model dynamics and limiting transfer quality.

arxiv-2512-07040.title: Transformation of Biological Networks into Images via Semantic Cartography for Visual Interpretation and Scalable Deep Analysis
arxiv-2512-07040.creator: Sakib Mostafa, Lei Xing, Md Tauhidul Islam
arxiv-2512-07040.description: Abstract Complex biological networks are fundamental to biomedical science, capturing interactions among molecules, cells, genes, and tissues. Deciphering these networks is critical for understanding health and disease, yet their scale and complexity represent a daunting challenge for current computational methods.

pmc-10517561.title: Medical experience as an influencing parameter in emergency medical care for psychiatric emergencies: retrospective analysis of a multicenter survey
pmc-10517561.creator: Benedikt Schick, Benjamin Mayer, Constanze Hensel, Sebastian Schmid, Bettina Jungwirth, Eberhard Barth, Claus-Martin Muth, Stephan Katzenschlager, Carlos Schönfeldt-Lecuona
pmc-10517561.description: BackgroundPrehospital care of psychiatric patients often relies on the medical experience of prehospital emergency physicians (PHEPs). The psychiatrists (PSs) involved in the further treatment of psychiatric patients also often rely on their experience. Furthermore, the interaction between PHEPs and PSs is characterized by interaction problems and different approaches in the prehospital care of the psychiatric emergency.

pmc-10627246.title: CRISPR-screen identifies ZIP9 and dysregulated Zn2+ homeostasis as a cause of cancer-associated changes in glycosylation
pmc-10627246.creator: Troels Boldt Rømer, Fawzi Khoder-Agha, Mikkel Koed Møller Aasted, Noortje de Haan, Sabrina Horn, August Dylander, Tao Zhang, Emil Marek Heymans Pallesen, Sally Dabelsteen, Manfred Wuhrer, Christine Flodgaard Høgsbro, Emil Aagaard Thomsen, Jacob Giehm Mikkelsen, Hans H Wandall
pmc-10627246.description: IntroductionIn epithelial cancers, truncated O-glycans, such as the Thomson-nouveau antigen (Tn) and its sialylated form (STn), are upregulated on the cell surface and associated with poor prognosis and immunological escape. Recent studies have shown that these carbohydrate epitopes facilitate cancer development and can be targeted therapeutically; however, the mechanism underpinning their expression remains unclear.

pmc-11668747.title: A systematic review of features and content quality of Arabic mental mHealth apps
pmc-11668747.creator: Noorah Ibrahim S. Alnaghaimshi, Mona S. Awadalla, Scott R. Clark, Mathias Baumert
pmc-11668747.description: IntroductionAnxiety and depression are major causes of disability in Arab countries, yet resources for mental health services are insufficient. Mobile devices may improve mental health care delivery (mental m-Health), but the Arab region's mental m-Health app landscape remains under-documented. This study aims to systematically assess the features, quality, and digital safety of mental m-Health apps available in the Arab marketplace.

pmc-12494972.title: Exploring Nigella Sativa’s medicinal capacity against skin cancer pathways using network pharmacology and molecular docking
pmc-12494972.creator: Ahmad M Alamri, Abdullah A Assiri, Amjad Yousuf, Najeeb Ullah Khan
pmc-12494972.description: Skin cancer is a growing global health concern, marked by high incidence and significant mortality, particularly in aggressive melanoma subtypes. In this study, we employed an integrative network pharmacology and molecular docking approach to evaluate the anticancer potential of Nigella sativa (black seed) against skin cancer. Initially, 13 active compounds were identified from N. sativa based on stringent pharmacokinetic criteria.

pmc-12552339.title: Overall survival and subsequent therapy patterns in Japanese patients with ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer treated with palbociclib plus letrozole in the first-line setting: a final analysis
pmc-12552339.creator: Masato Takahashi, Hiroyuki Yasojima, Tomofumi Osako, Kenichi Inoue, Masahiro Kawashima, Hideki Maeda, Mitsuya Ito, Yasuaki Sagara, Kan Yonemori, Masaya Hattori, Naohito Yamamoto, Yasuaki Muramatsu, Akiko Matsui, Norikazu Masuda
pmc-12552339.description: BackgroundAn open-label, single-arm, multicenter Japanese phase 2 study (J-Ph2) found first-line palbociclib plus letrozole to be effective and tolerable in postmenopausal Japanese women with estrogen receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (ER+/HER2–) advanced breast cancer (ABC), but overall survival (OS) data were immature. Here, we report the final analysis of a follow-up study of J-Ph2 evaluating OS and subsequent therapy.

pmc-13346827.title: Immunogenicity remodeling in hepatocellular carcinoma: mechanisms and translational strategies
pmc-13346827.creator: Yali Li, Ying Yan, Jingwei Ma, Lingzhi Liao, Jing Liu, Jiahui Ma, Yile Qi, Zhijian Han, Hao Chen
pmc-13346827.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) continues to pose a significant global health challenge. In recent years, immunotherapy has emerged as a critical component of HCC treatment, demonstrating encouraging outcomes in a subset of patients. Nevertheless, the overall response rate to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) remains modest.

pmc-13361253.title: Programmable 3D Photovoltaics via Mechanically Origami‐Coded Interlocked 3D Kirigami and Nano‐Root Anchored AgNWs–In–Ga Multiphasic Alloy Conductor
pmc-13361253.creator: Seok Joon Hwang, Jiwon Ryu, Byungsoo Kang, Injong Oh, Dae‐Hee Cho, YoungHoi Cho, Seung S Lee, Dong Hoe Kim, Deokjae Choi, Gee Yeong Kim, Heesuk Jung, Taehee Kim, Hyeonggeun Yu, Seungjun Chung, Byoung Koun Min, Phillip Lee
pmc-13361253.description: 3D photovoltaics (3DPVs) are highly promising for next‐generation energy systems, as they maximize space utilization and power output. However, most reported 3DPVs remain unsuitable for deformable applications. When 3DPVs are integrated with mechanically deformable platforms, a fundamental trade‐off emerges: achieving large mechanical stretchability typically leads to a reduction in areal coverage.

pmc-13395575.title: Biosystematics and Taxonomic Treatment of Three New Kengyilia Species in the Triticeae (Poaceae)
pmc-13395575.creator: Xiao‐Yang Pan, Shuang‐Dan Li, Chang‐Bing Zhang, Jia‐Yue He, Yuan‐Yuan Lu, Ting‐Ting Zheng, Ying‐Hui Li, Li‐Li Xu, Hai‐Qin Zhang, Hou‐Yang Kang, Dan‐Dan Wu, Yong‐Hong Zhou

pmc-13473123.title: A triboelectric radical generation route to chlorine disinfectants from brine
pmc-13473123.creator: Han Qian, Jianming Liu, Ning Wu, Shaoxin Li, Xinhong Song, Feiyao Yang, Morten Willatzen, Jiajia Shao, Vishnu Shankar, Daping Chu, Richard N. Zare, Zhong Lin Wang, Di Wei
pmc-13473123.description: Contact electrification (CE), one of the earliest documented physical phenomena, has traditionally been associated with triboelectric charging but rarely considered as a driver of chemical transformations. Here we show that CE generates radicals at solid-liquid interfaces, establishing contact-electro-chemistry (CE-Chemistry) as a metal-catalyst-free route that uses ambient mechanical energy.

pmc-13487744.title: Associations between COVID-19 pandemic experiences and suicidal ideation among adolescents: the mediating role of life satisfaction, subjective wellbeing, and anxiety
pmc-13487744.creator: Helena Jeriček Klanšček, Petra Mikolič Brence, Carolina Blanco Calvo, Saška Roškar, Špela Selak, Matej Vinko
pmc-13487744.description: IntroductionThe aim of this study was to examine associations between adolescents’ experiences during the COVID-19 pandemic and life satisfaction, subjective wellbeing, anxiety, and suicidal ideation.MethodsData were drawn from the 2022 cross-national Health Behavior in School-aged Children study conducted in Slovenia, using a representative sample of 8,638 adolescents aged 11, 13, 15, and 17 years (51.7% girls).

pmc-13589510.title: Global gut microbiome atlas identifies epidemiologic-stage-specific signatures in inflammatory bowel disease
pmc-13589510.creator: Jinxia Zhai, Yingjie Li, Jiameng Liu, Xinyi Su, Runze Cui, Dianyu Zheng, Yuhan Sun, Jingsheng Yu, Cong Dai
pmc-13589510.description: SummaryThe global rise of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) reflects environmental shifts, yet how these changes are embedded in the gut microbial ecology remains unclear. We construct a microbiome atlas comprising 245,627 profiles. By classifying countries into three epidemiologic stages, we establish a framework. As the IBD burden increases, the gut microbial alpha diversity declines, and community structures form distinct clusters.

pmc-13637316.title: Adapting family-based therapy for anorexia nervosa to an inpatient setting: staff experiences and perspectives
pmc-13637316.creator: Jan-Vegard Nilsen
pmc-13637316.description: BackgroundFamily-based therapy is an outpatient treatment model strongly recommended as a first-line intervention for adolescents with anorexia nervosa. A central feature of the model is the active involvement of parents in meal support and in the treatment process as a whole. Although outpatient Family-based therapy is effective for many families, a substantial proportion of young people require inpatient treatment.
